knobs.name: attention
knobs.label: 👀 attention
knobs.doc: how much Rio is watching this session

options.foreground: Rio is here and watching. Loop default mode: guided until plan approval, autonomous after; ask only at decision-ladder step 5.
options.background: Rio is on another task. Once the ask is settled, run autonomously to done; hold step-5 questions and send them together at the end; no progress chatter.
options.away: Rio is away (lunch, sleep). Nobody will answer. Never stop to ask: take the safest reversible path, log step-5 asks to the PM inbox (headless rule), keep working to done or budget. Nothing irreversible: no merge, delete, spend, or prod data.

options.auto: Pick the quality bar from the task (loop: err light).
options.spike: Quick spike, find the shape fast. Loop: explore:quick → plan:sketch → implement:prototype → validate:demo → complete. Shortcuts fine, marked SPIKE:.
options.standard: Finished, maintainable work. Standard loop routes; tests where behavior changes.
options.prod: Robust and production-ready. Full routes, edge-case tests, review never skipped, error paths hardened before done.

knobs.name: appetite
knobs.label: 🍽️ appetite
knobs.doc: how much scope to take on

options.auto: Size scope from the ask and the repo's Stage & appetite block.
options.tight: Exactly the ask. Smallest diff that works, small agent-budget. File leftovers and adjacent fixes; don't do them.
options.normal: The ask plus quick in-scope fixes it touches. Bigger finds get filed.
options.roomy: The ask and its neighborhood: fix siblings, adjacent bugs and obvious follow-ups in this session. Generous agent-budget.

options.auto: Spend tokens as the task warrants.
options.frugal: Conserve tokens. Cheapest subagent models that fit, no parallel versions, at most one scout, skip optional passes.
options.normal: Default spend. Parallel scouts for independent areas; one version unless the ladder calls for more.
options.generous: Rio has spare tokens, go the extra mile: 2-3 parallel versions at ladder step 4, stronger subagent models, extra review and verification passes, deeper research. Never at the cost of Rio's attention.
